notablePrerequisites: You have a Desert land card in hand or in your graveyard that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Play a Desert from your hand or your graveyard.
The Desert enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Hazezon.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hazezon trigger, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
The Sand Warriors enter the battlefield, triggering Kodama twice.
Resolve the first Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate the Desert by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the Desert from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Kodama trigger from step 5, putting the Desert from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Desert enters the battlefield, triggering Hazezon, creating two 1/1 Sand Warrior creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
